summary:
That's the Spirit! is a video game following the 2nd rover to have ever ventured the Martian land. Spirit used cameras and Rock Abrasion Tool (RAT) to help humanity explore ground-breaking discoveries, such as finding evidence of water on Mars. In this video game, you follow Spirit's journey to uncover the missions it went through and the challenges faced along the way. For instance, taking pictures to form a panorama, grinding and examining the rocky surface of Mars and the trouble of following the power of the Sun on a dusty planet by moving the solar panels. This video game was made possible with GDevelop and teamwork.

Following the theme of Abandoned but not Forgotten, our goal is to commemorate the past tools sent out to space who risked the dangers of outer space to help humanity on Earth to expand our knowledge beyond the skies. By weaving historical facts, beginner game developing skills and 10 years of exposure to English media, team Women Ai Space made That's the Spirit! to tell the story of Spirit as well as remind the people that you are never forgotten no matter how far you go. In the wise words of Evan Hansen, you will be found. 

This public educational game has a mission to help inform and encourage the youth's interests in space and STEM via interactive learning, and also to express our own passion through known mediums. Through the story of Spirit, players can find themselves wandering Mars and an envelope from yours truly containing a bit of hope. Thankyou
details: That's the Spirit! is a video game that tells the story through the perspective of the Spirit rover that was sent to Mars in 2004. Players experience what it is like to be a rover through minigames like rearranging multiple scattered images to form a panorama, inclining the solar panels towards the Sun to maximise power generation during the Winter, visiting the areas where Nasa scientists led Spirit to go and more. It has an atmospheric 3D recreation of the Martian surface based on images captured by the Sprit rover while it was still active that intend to tell the endearing story of Sprit's journey. Through this experience, players are able to form a new appreciation of the past, as well as understanding that space isn't just scary, it can often times be very beautiful. That's the Spirit stands on the side of scientific accuracy, where players are able to be educate themselves about space through real-world knowledge integrated into the gameplay. This project intends to take advantage of the addiction of the youth towards video games and attempt to develop an appreciation for the cosmos amongst the younger generation through a familiar medium. Our team utilised GDevelop to develop our project.
